changelog: v0.6.4: iPhone web-port fixes. Dual-touch aim: look deltas are now computed per touch index (the engine's drag 'relative' is unreliable on mobile browsers with a second finger down), and the joystick is single-owner so a second finger can't steal the stick mid-drag. First-use / after-idle warmup: a web-only 'Warming up…' pass during the main menu builds the FX/debris/tracer pools early and renders every material once so WebGL shaders compile before gameplay; a frame gap over 8s (suspended tab) triggers a light rewarm. Honest limit: the first seconds after a long idle may still feel soft (WASM re-tiering); a fully evicted tab is a full reload. Web build refreshed at /play/.
